title: Zainab (s.a) Tere Putran ne Enj Di Wafa Nibahi.
body:
Veeran(A) Da Sadqa Kar Ke Putran Nu Toreya Eh
Lut Gayi Eh Karbala Vich Zainab(sa) Di Kul Kamayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Be Kafn Laashay Chad Ke Tur Paye Eh Shaam Pasaay
Na Royi Zindagi Saari Putran Nu Zahra(sa) Jayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar(A) De Vaang Bibi Naazan De Naal Palay
Rehtaanch Rul Gaye Ne
Kisay Laash Na Uthayee
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab(sa) Di Nasal Muk Gaye Chadar Rai Na Sir Te
Ik Saal Qaid Kat Ke Bin Putran Ghar Ch Aye
